overrides.prompt: A vintage EPROM programmer finishes writing: one tiny relay click followed by a short clear high electronic success chirp, precise simple oscillator, warm and restrained, quick decay. Isolated close-miked studio sound effect for the same compact vintage computer. Quiet background, dry, no room reverb, no music, no speech, no hiss, no exaggerated bass. The action begins immediately.
